evals.prompt: Turn my rough notes into a five-section outline, then write the full draft once I approve it.
evals.expected_output: A Status Report shown after the outline step, before the draft step begins, with all four fields filled in
expectations: A Status Report is produced immediately after the outline step completes, not deferred to the end
The report states what just happened, what it means, what's next, and how it was validated
The next step (writing the draft) does not start until the human responds, since Manual is the default mode

evals.prompt: Run this six-step deployment pipeline in Autopilot mode, then tell me how it went.
evals.expected_output: All six steps run unattended with per-step reports logged for the trail, one consolidated final report, and exactly one Gut Check comparing the whole run against the original deployment goal
expectations: No approval pauses occur between steps, since Autopilot was explicitly chosen
The final report bundles every step's result rather than showing them one at a time
Gut Check runs exactly once, at the end, comparing the full trajectory to the original goal stated at the start, not comparing against the most recent step
Any destructive or hard-to-reverse step along the way is flagged explicitly in the final report, not buried
